# Vitralume

> An AI job application copilot. Vitralume analyses how well your resume fits a
> job posting, optimises it for ATS keyword screening, matches your background
> against company research, and drafts cover letters that stay truthful to what
> is actually in your profile.

Vitralume is a single-page web app served entirely from `/`. Visitors see a
public landing page; signing in swaps the same URL for a private workspace
(dashboard, applications, resume profile, settings). There are no separate
crawlable URLs for the workspace.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Tash000/job-fit-ai#readme): What Vitralume does, how it is built, and how to run it locally.
- [Contributing guide](https://github.com/Tash000/job-fit-ai/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and pull-request conventions.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/Tash000/job-fit-ai/blob/main/SECURITY.md): How to report a vulnerability.
- [Code of conduct](https://github.com/Tash000/job-fit-ai/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): Community expectations.

- [Vitralume](https://vitralume.vercel.app/): Public landing page and entry point to the workspace.
